verdict.rationale: First-party docs say you can connect multiple Gmail and Outlook accounts (work, personal, side projects), switch between them instantly without changing apps, and add every account's calendar in one view. The evidence covers only Gmail and Outlook, though; nothing shows IMAP or other-provider support, which is a significant part of the story. Missing for 10: IMAP/generic-provider account support, evidence of a truly unified multi-account inbox (beyond account switching), independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-account use.
